thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: us-east-1b inference fleet: elevated connection timeouts and 502s to model endpoints. Thresholds breached: connection-timeout > 10% for 2 minutes. Alert: https://redwood.ops/alerts/2419991234 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): On it. Seeing a surge of upstream 502s from our inference gateway logs, mostly egress failures to local ENIs and NAT. Kicking off quick triage.

pagerduty-bot: Paging alex (oncall) -> acknowledged by alex (oncall).

priya (sre): Alex, can you paste a recent tail of the gateway error log? I want to see error class. Also check host-level packet drops and conntrack exhaustion.

alex (oncall): Paste: ```2026-03-15T03:12:02Z gateway[proxy]: upstream_connect_error: dial tcp 10.0.45.23:443: connect: connection timed out
2026-03-15T03:12:03Z gateway[proxy]: upstream_response_error: status 502 from 10.0.45.23
2026-03-15T03:12:05Z gateway[proxy]: downstream reset from client, conn closed
```

tom (infra): I'm seeing high NAT gateway errors and SNAT exhaustion on a subset of subnets in us-east-1b. AWS health: "impaired network connectivity" for us-east-1b reported 03:09Z. Route tables look fine but a set of ENIs are reporting Rx overruns.

laura (eng-runtime): If SNAT is the limiter, requests will drop for short-lived connections. We should switch inference egress to keep-alive connections and reuse connections to reduce SNAT pressure, and steer traffic to us-east-1c. Also we can enable our regional HTTP proxy pool in us-west-2 as a temporary egress path.

alex (oncall): Changing route preference now: `rwctl route set --region us-east-1 --avoid-az us-east-1b --drain-seconds 60` will stop new sessions to 1b and leak old ones. Leaving a small shadow to monitor.

eng-status-bot: Status page: "Intermittent 502s for inference in us-east-1b; mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes."

cs-ops: Any idea which customers are affected? We have 3 open tickets mentioning timeouts. Need a short note we can send to customers.

priya (sre): Telemetry: ~9% of requests from the hosted API in us-east-1b failed with 502 between 03:08-03:14Z. Dedicated customers pinned to us-east-1b saw increased latency; one Dedicated account had a burst of 50% of short-lived sessions failing. Not a full outage but user-visible errors for a subset.

laura (eng-runtime): Deploying keep-alive proxy change now: `deploy proxy --env=prod --region=us-east-1 --opts "keepalive=1m max-conns=2000"` Should reduce ephemeral SNAT consumption. Also patching runtime to prefer upstream connection reuse: `PATCH runtime-config: reuseConnections=true`.

tom (infra): I'm requesting AWS support escalation for the AZ network impairment and provisioning spare ENIs from our reserved pool to replace noisy hosts. Opening ticket: SR-83421. AWS response ETA ~10m.

alex (oncall): Posting to #customer-status: "We're seeing transient 502s in us-east-1b due to an AZ network issue. We're steering traffic to adjacent AZ and enabling connection reuse to mitigate. Some customers may see short errors; we'll follow up." Priya, can you include the affected prefixes/ASG so CS can map accounts?

priya (sre): Affected ASGs: eu1b-inference-* and us1b-g5-pool. Will attach list to the incident doc.

pagerduty-bot: alex (oncall) acknowledged. On-call handover reminder set for +30m.

eng-status-bot: Public status page refreshed.

laura (eng-runtime): Runtime metrics: connection reuse rollout at 45% of gateway nodes. Early signal: SNAT port usage per-host dropping 30% on patched hosts. 502 rate down from 9% -> 3.4%.

tom (infra): Autoscaling in us-east-1c initiated to absorb shifted traffic: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group use1c-g5 --desired-capacity 18`. Warm pool also increased. ETA for healthy instances ~4m.

priya (sre): Packet drop graphs show two host racks in us-east-1b with sustained Rx overruns correlated to 5xx spikes. Likely a localized NIC/host hardware issue but AWS network plane note suggests broader fabric degradation.

cs-ops: Message sent to affected customers with preliminary info. Response expected from three enterprise accounts requesting a forced failover.

alex (oncall): For dedicated stacks, we'll need account consent to force failover (we don't automatically move Dedicated without opt-in). I'll DM account owners and offer to fail them over to 1c; if they don't respond within 15m we won't force.

laura (eng-runtime): I've also rolled a lightweight q8 model variant into us-east-1c for latency-sensitive low-cost routing: `deploy variant q8_2 --region use1c --scale 6`. This will help absorb load.

tom (infra): AWS updated SR: "some instances in us-east-1b experiencing hardware offload errors; replacement works scheduled." ETA unknown. We're monitoring for scheduled host replacements.

priya (sre): Current impact numbers: overall 2.5% of global inference requests affected due to steering; in-region impact for us-east-1b currently 3.1% errors but trending down as reuse/steer takes effect.

eng-status-bot: Status updated: "Degraded performance in us-east-1b. Mitigation: traffic steering and connection reuse. Next update in 10 minutes."

alex (oncall): Handoff note to Priya (secondary) in 25m. Summary: suspected AZ-level NIC offload/hardware causing SNAT exhaustion and connection resets -> 502s. Actions: steer new traffic off AZ, enable keep-alive & connection reuse, scale up 1c capacity, offer Dedicated failover to customers. Metrics to watch: SNAT port utilization, upstream 502 rate, ENI Rx overruns, ASG instance health.

cs-ops: Affected enterprise accounts approved forced failover for two dedicated stacks. Alex, coordinate maintenance windows?

alex (oncall): Will initiate dedicated forced failovers for consenting accounts: `rwctl dedicated failover --account acct-1234 --from use1b --to use1c --drain 120`. Doing acct-1234 now.

laura (eng-runtime): Runtime reports reduced 502s for traffic now served from 1c and us-west fallback. KV cache cold starts visible but acceptable; latency stable.

tom (infra): Autoscaling complete in 1c. New instances healthy. AWS confirmed replacement scheduling for impacted hosts; ETA updated to 40-60m.

priya (sre): 502 rate now ~0.9% for the affected window; SNAT ports recovered on many patched hosts. Continuing to monitor for 1h before declaring resolved.

eng-status-bot: Public update posted: "Improvement observed; mitigation continuing. Some Dedicated stacks have been failed over with customer consent. We'll provide a full incident report after root cause confirmed."

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Adding recommended follow-ups to postmortem: consider auto-trigger steering when per-AZ SNAT exhaustion crosses 40% and improve monitoring of host offload errors to trigger earlier replacement.

priya (sre): I'll own postmortem draft and RCA once AWS provides final host replacement confirmation.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged. Handoff to Priya in 25m.

eng-status-bot: Final update scheduled at +60m.

alex (oncall): Handoff complete. Priya taking channel. If anything spikes ping me directly. :phone:

priya (sre): Taking over monitoring. Closing this thread for on-call rotation. Remember to tag postmortem owners and affected account leads.
